players.capacityPolicy: Do not advertise capacity until implementation and test establish it.

connection.setup: Generate recipe.multiplayer with Melty setup_multiplayer; do not hand-invent fields.

requiredAcceptanceTests: Host launches from Melty Play with both game components.
Melty provides a host join address and the game records it in the expected log.
Second installed game copy joins without typing an address or forwarding router ports.
Both clients observe the same encounter and player roster.
Mob damage, police encounter events, and explosion events are not duplicated or lost.
Submit host and join logs to Melty multiplayer testing tools.
